title: Dark Horse Rises
next_chapter_hook: The turtle shell's temperature continued to rise, and Chen Ji felt something awakening within him—was this the opportunity to break through, or an even greater crisis?

text.content: Before the crowd could recover from their shock, the turtle shell in his arms burned hot once more, an ancient power dormant for ages was about to break free... Chen Ji suppressed the churning in his heart, knowing this wasn't the moment for enlightenment—Han Lie was already approaching.

dialogue.content: Trash, you think winning a few matches can change your fate?

text.content: With each step Han Lie took, the ground trembled slightly. His aura pressed down like a mountain, and surrounding servant disciples stepped back, faces filled with reverence. The title of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius was not given for nothing.

dialogue.content: Han Shixiong is right, I am indeed just trash.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice betraying no emotionalfluctuation. But his right hand had already secretly clenched—three breaths later, it would be the moment when Han Lie knelt. The turtle shell's heat was accelerating its transmission, a majestic power surging through his meridians.

choice.prompt: Facing the aggressive Han Lie, how will you establish your authority before the final battle?

choices.text: Continue to show weakness, enticing him to underestimate and overextend
choices.description: Let Han Lie believe you have no counterattack ability, then make a desperate counterattack when he goes all out, pushing the humiliation to its extreme.
choices.visible_cost: Must endure Han Lie's initial suppression
choices.risk_hint: Risk if turtle shell awakening is not timely

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his eyes filled with 'fear'. He stumbled back two steps, accidentally stepping on a stone behind him, falling to the ground. The surrounding crowd burst into laughter, Han Lie's contempt in his eyes growing even stronger.

choices.description: Use silence and presence to tell everyone—you're not worth another glance. This mental suppression is more lethal than words.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Han Lie to go all out
choices.visible_reward: Victory on the spiritual level first

text.content: Chen Ji merely glanced at Han Lie coolly, that gaze as calm as looking at a roadside rock. 'Oh.' Only one word, yet Han Lie's face instantly flushed red—this feeling of being completely ignored was more maddening than any mockery.

The turtle shell's heat broke through some critical point, and Chen Ji felt a cool power flood from his dantian into his limbs. The sign of breakthrough—yet he had to suppress it, at least until here, in front of everyone, he thoroughly trampled Han Lie underfoot.

Han Lie roared, his Xuanwu True Force灌注双拳, bringing a piercing scream as he thundered toward Chen Ji. The onlookers all changed color—this single punch was enough to split stones! Yet Chen Ji stood motionless, as if paralyzed by fear.

choice.prompt: Han Lie's full-power strike has arrived, how will you end this confrontation?

choices.text: Use the same technique to defeat him with his own methods
choices.description: Defeat him head-on with the same move, making Han Lie lose with complete conviction, proving your talent far surpasses his.
choices.visible_reward: All spectators shocked, best face-slapping effect

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, the movement看似缓慢, yet precisely meeting Han Lie's fist. The moment their fists collided, the Xuanwu True Force was directly shattered, Han Lie's body flying backward like a kite with cut strings.

text.content: With a deafening crash, Han Lie slammed down over thirty feet away, raising endless dust. Silence—the entire Martial Arena was so quiet a needle drop could be heard, everyone's jaw nearly hitting the ground.

choices.text: Four liang拨千斤, breaking force with skill
choices.description: Use the smallest cost to demonstrate absolute strength gap, leaving him clueless about how he lost.
choices.risk_hint: May be considered as taking advantage

text.content: Chen Ji sidestepped, avoiding the lethal strike at an unbelievable angle. Then, his fingers gently pushed Han Lie's back—seemingly light, yet sending the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius directly sprawling, face-first into the dirt.

Han Lie struggled to stand, only to find his legs wouldn't obey. Chen Ji's palm, though gentle, had precisely sealed several of his acupoints. At this moment, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius knelt before the trash he had once most despised.

Chen Ji's voice held no波澜, as if he had merely done something insignificant. Yet it was precisely this composure that made everyone present feel a bone-deep chill—could this still be that person who任由欺辱的trash?
Just then, an authoritative voice came from the high platform. 'Chen Ji.' The Fifth Elder had somehow risen, his murky old eyes flickering with a gleam of light. 'Who was your master?'

choice.prompt: The Fifth Elder publicly inquires about your master, how will you respond?

choices.description: Insist you are self-taught with no master, letting everyone continue believing you got lucky.
choices.visible_cost: May arouse the Fifth Elder's suspicion
choices.risk_hint: Excessive humility may invite deeper investigation

dialogue.content: Reporting to Elder, this disciple is merely a servant, what master could I possibly have? It's merely that I observed senior brothers training and figured things out on my own.

text.content: The Fifth Elder narrowed his eyes, his gaze sharp as a blade. 'Self-taught prodigy? Interesting.' His tone carried deep meaning. 'It seems this old man has underestimated you before.'

choices.text: Go with the flow, hint at guidance from an expert
choices.description: Reveal having encountered a senior who gave pointers, but cannot elaborate, leaving the Fifth Elder with endless speculation.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Sect's attention,争取更多资源
choices.risk_hint: The expert's identity may become a focus of questioning

dialogue.content: Reporting to Elder, this disciple did indeed encounter a senior who gave some guidance. However, that senior came and went without trace, and this disciple doesn't know their identity either.

text.content: The Fifth Elder nodded thoughtfully. 'To teach a disciple like you, that senior must be a remarkable person.' He suddenly shifted topics. 'Would you be willing to become my disciple?'

This statement caused an uproar throughout the hall. The Fifth Elder—one of the five highest decision-makers of Tianqing Sect—was publicly wanting to take a servant disciple as his student? Han Lie's expression had already reached its ugliest point—he had wanted to use today's match to restore his reputation, yet unknowingly elevated Chen Ji's fame.

However, just then, an ancient yet authoritative voice descended from the clouds. 'Fifth Elder, you have good taste, but this disciple... I am also very interested.' Everyone looked up to see a figure stepping out from the void—it was Tianqing Sect's old Sect Master—Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, right? This old man has been watching you for quite some time.

text.content: Ling Yuan's words made Chen Ji's heart tighten. He knew this old fox would never speak without purpose—'watching for quite some time,' was this genuine appreciation, or had he already sensed something? The turtle shell's heat rose once more, Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his inner vigilance, his face showing appropriate flattered surprise.

dialogue.content: Sect Master... this disciple is unworthy...

text.content: Ling Yuan looked down at Chen Ji, his gaze profound and unfathomable. 'Your achievements today are no accident. This old man would like to invite you... to my meditation chamber for a private discussion.' His tone was商量, his eyes were command. The Fifth Elder's expression slightly changed, yet he made no move to stop it.

Chen Ji felt a chill rise along his spine. Was Ling Yuan's invitation fortune or misfortune? Had he sensed the existence of the Tianji Record? But with all eyes upon him, he simply could not refuse. Chen Ji took a deep breath and respectfully bowed.

Ling Yuan nodded satisfied, turned, and vanished into thin air. The Fifth Elder looked at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in his eyes. As for Han Lie, he had already been carried away by accompanying disciples—that dejected背影 became the biggest joke of the day.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind) Lad, well done. But the upcoming meditation chamber invitation... be careful.

text.content: The turtle shell's heat had become scalding, Chen Ji felt the power within him about to lose control. Claiming to change clothes, he came to a secluded corner and took out the turtle shell. A faint golden light leaked from the cracks, the second page of the Tianji Record was slowly unsealing—yet he faintly sensed that the gears of fate had already begun turning toward an unknown direction.
